annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that if all compatible RRs indicate "no-default-alpn", clients MAY reject the entire RRSet and fall back to basic connection establishment, even if a non-default ALPN could have succeeded. No alternative reasonable interpretation or missing constraint is evident.
